name: polimi-lectures
description: Polimi lecture recordings with transcripts, AI chapters and an AI assistant (web app + LectureMind chatbot).

scripts.dev: npm run chatbot & npm run web
scripts.dev:fake: npm run chatbot:fake & npm run web
scripts.test: npm run test:web && npm run test:chatbot
scripts.test:chatbot: cd services/chatbot && python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -t .
